messages:
acme_cto: Hey team — we're hitting a bunch of 429s from the API during our morning ingest window. Started ~08:15 UTC. Example response headers from one request: 

  HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
  x-rate-limit-limit: 60
  x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
  Retry-After: 30

Requests are from 4 worker processes with the same API key. Can you confirm whether this is concurrency or token-level quota? Our plan is still on the free tier.

peter_support: Thanks for the repro snippet. Looks like you hit the per-minute token/req window (x-rate-limit-limit). Free-tier concurrency/throughput is small — 60 req/min in this case. Are those 4 workers sharing a single API key? If so they'll share the quota.

acme_cto: Yes, all workers use the same key (legacy setup). Traffic pattern: short bursts of 200 small requests over 3 minutes every hour. We expected retries to smooth it.

nora_oncall: @peter_support quick note from runtime: the cluster matched the free-tier rate limiter, and when remaining=0 requests get immediate 429s. Our logs show client-side retries hammering the limit again, producing repeated 429s. Short term workaround: stagger worker retries with jitter + exponential backoff and add a token-bucket on your side so bursts don't hit the shared key all at once.

peter_support: For support path: we can offer a 24-hour temporary concurrency bump if you fill out a one-pager (use-case, expected qps, team contact). @jen_sales can coordinate pricing/approval for longer-term increase.

jen_sales: I can take this. Free->paid transition options: monthly reserved capacity (for predictable QPS) or pay-as-you-go with higher default quotas. For an immediate short window we can do a manual uplift of the plan cap — need customer org ID and billing contact. If they want sustained throughput, reserved capacity is cheaper. I’ll DM the checklist. :+1: 

acme_cto: We need the temporary uplift for a 6-hour demo tomorrow (UTC 14:00–20:00). Org ID is ACME-42 and billing contact is ops@acme.io. What's the turnaround?

jen_sales: If you provide a signed confirmation and a good-faith estimate (peak qps and duration) we can usually action the temporary bump within 2 hours during business hours. For 6 hours I can do a sales-assisted uplift to the next tier. I’ll open the sales ticket now.

nora_oncall: Engineering notes for the handoff: recommend these immediate mitigations to reduce blast to the rate limiter: 
- Rotate to multiple API keys per worker (per-service key) so quotas aren't all on one token.
- Implement client-side queueing and concurrency cap (max 10 concurrent requests per process).
- Use batching where possible (combine multiple items into 1 request).

peter_support: Logging action: support created INC-1766664444, included headers, sample curl, and CPU/worker counts. Assigned to sales for uplift and to oncall for mitigation advice.

acme_cto: Sample curl we used: 

  curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" 
    -d '{"input":"small payload"}' 
    https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate

Got back 429 twice in a row even after 10s wait. We'll implement jitter/backoff today.

billing-bot: Billing note: ACME-42 is eligible for a one-time trial uplift (credit card on file required). For paid tier we need PO or credit card and acceptance of TOS. I'll flag the org in billing after sales confirms.

jen_sales: Added a temporary uplift request to the sales tracker, pinging finance. Please confirm when you've added retry jitter and split keys so we can avoid re-issuing an uplift.

acme_cto: Confirmed — we'll stagger retries and rotate keys by EOD. Can you confirm the uplift window once approved?

jen_sales: Will confirm in this thread when uplift is active. :white_check_mark:

nora_oncall: Follow-up: if you see 429 with Retry-After > 10s please stop retries until header expires. Otherwise clients can cause a thundering herd. We can also add a short-lived fallback that queues requests to a background worker instead of retrying synchronously.

peter_support: Closing loop: support will keep INC open until uplift is confirmed and customer reports no more 429s during test window. Thanks all.
